symbols.read: BNBUSDT remains below the 722.40 trigger at 720.11, and the combined 4H+1H stance has flipped back from HOLD to SELL as 1H alignment returned to the bearish side — restoring the short setup that was flagged invalidated in the prior read. The bearish FVG at 726.00–726.48 still caps bounces, keeping the path toward 686.36 intact, with 737.02 as the invalidation level that would reopen the bullish flip toward 758.44. Bias is bearish within a BULLISH regime, so this stays a counter-trend short; holding below 722.40 sustains downside pressure, while a reclaim of 737.02 kills the structure.

Price at 81,550.23 is holding above the 81,033.66 lower pivot but the 4H has flipped back to bearish and the 1H trend is down, so the neutral-to-constructive stance from the prior read is revised back to a bearish lean. The regime tag still reads BULLISH and the combined 4H+1H sits at HOLD, but the last 1H candle closed -0.20% (81,781.18→81,615.64), failing to build on the earlier bounce. A fresh bull FVG at 81,475.96–81,524.00 sits just below price and is the immediate downside magnet; losing it opens 81,033.66. Invalidation: a clean break below 81,033.66 reopens the short toward 77,715.32, while acceptance above 84,352.00 restores the bullish flip.

Price has held above the 2,403.69 lower pivot and printed a small bull FVG at 2,420.97–2,422.39, so the prior cautious-short lean is now under pressure even as the 1H trend stays down and the combined regime reads SELL. The overhead bear FVG at 2,446–2,455 remains the key resistance — reclaiming it would neutralize the bearish case, while a sustained break below 2,403.69 confirms the 4H bearish path toward 2,227.50. Note the listed SELL setup is already invalidated (stop 2,402.67 sits above entry 2,403.69, and regime reads BULLISH), so this is a conflicted tape, not a clean short. Bias: neutral-to-cautious-short only while 2,403.69 holds as support; invalidation is a break below 2,403.69 for the bear case, or a reclaim of 2,446 for the bull case.

Bias stays bearish and the short remains invalidated: price at 104.29 is still below the 107.16 lower pivot, so the 107.16 entry with stop 107.19 and target 100.92 cannot be armed. What changed from the prior read is a modest bounce — price recovered from 103.69 to 104.29, and the last 1H candle is flat-to-up at 104.42→104.45, though the 1H trend itself remains down, so this is drift rather than a reversal. With no open FVGs, there is still no structural support beneath, keeping the path toward 100.92 open. Invalidation of the bearish lean remains a reclaim of 107.16; until that prints, the bias is unchanged and nothing is live.

Price has edged to 56.97, extending the 4H bearish structure further below the 58.41 lower pivot, with the combined signal now SELL — the prior neutral-to-softly-bearish bias is confirmed and hardened as the 1H trend stays down. The 58.41 short entry remains expired and untriggered with stop 58.58 and target 55.37 untouched, and the bearish FVG at 57.42–57.53 still caps as the nearest supply overhead. The 1H resilience flagged in the last read is fully gone, so the timeframe conflict stays resolved in the bears' favor. A sustained reclaim of 58.41 flips the read bullish toward 61.45 and kills the short thesis; rejection at the 57.42–57.53 FVG keeps 55.37 as the downside objective.

The combined read has slipped from BUY back to HOLD as the 1H stalled at 4,168.84 and closed -0.08% at 4,165.42, so the resumed push higher has lost momentum rather than broken down. With no open FVGs, price trades on structure alone between the 4,217.40 upper pivot and 4,141.44 lower pivot, and the invalidated SELL setup stays dead with its 4,141.44 entry untouched. Bias is neutral-to-long: the 4H remains bullish and 1H trend is still up, but conviction is weaker than the prior read. Invalidation is unchanged — a sustained break below 4,141.44 flips the combined read bearish and re-arms the 4,065.48 target.

The prior neutral-to-short read is confirmed and now formally invalidated as a live SELL: price has reclaimed the 1.31 lower pivot that the previous read flagged as the invalidation trigger, so the short from 1.31 is dead. Bias is neutral-to-short again, not long — the 4H direction is bearish and the 1H trend remains down, with the 1.31→1.31 (+0.08%) close showing no real upside impulse. The two bear FVGs at 1.3154–1.328 and 1.3283–1.3297 still cap price and remain the operative resistance, so any push into that zone is a fade, not a breakout. Invalidation: a decisive hold above 1.3283–1.3297 voids the bearish structure and reopens 1.43; failure to clear 1.3154 keeps 1.20 in play.
